entity.name: Marcos Recio
entity.description: Independent software developer in Spain. I build deterministic developer tooling: license-compatibility checking (canreuse) and a diagnostic harness for codebases (galaxy-brain). Development is openly AI-assisted under my direction and review, and every rule or claim ships with tests and cited sources.

projects.name: canreuse
projects.description: Can I reuse this? A deterministic, directional license-compatibility check: given material under license A and a project under license B, it answers allowed / allowed-with-obligations / review / disallowed / unknown, with machine-readable output and exit codes, and it fails safe — contested or unrecognised cases never produce a green light. Built for the moment of reuse (CI, pre-commit, AI coding agents), not for after-the-fact inventory.

projects.name: galaxy-brain
projects.description: The deterministic harness a coding agent should be standing on: code shape, call graph, diff impact and crash state in milliseconds, offline, with no model in the loop. One CLI, 17 languages, zero runtime dependencies.
